summary.lv: Rietumu Banka meklē IT atbalsta speciālistu Help Desk komandā, kurš pieņems un reģistrēs IKT pieteikumus, diagnosticēs datoru un programmatūras problēmas un atbalstīs bankas darbiniekus.
summary.en: Rietumu Banka is seeking an IT Help Desk Specialist to accept and register IKT requests, diagnose hardware and software issues, and provide technical support to bank employees.
